privacy.metaDesc: Learn how the intellij-deodorant-reborn platform collects, uses, and protects your personal data in compliance with GDPR.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Dateng Tankoua Emery Josian ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use the intellij-deodorant-reborn platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law.
privacy.s1p1: The data controller responsible for processing your personal data is:
privacy.s1p2: Dateng Tankoua Emery Josian · Germany · datengtankoua@gmail.com
privacy.s1p3: This is a non-commercial, private open-source portfolio project. No Data Protection Officer (DPO) is required under Art. 37 GDPR.
privacy.s2p1: We collect only the minimum data necessary to operate the platform:
privacy.s2Item1: Anonymous download statistics — aggregate plugin download counts only. No IP address or browser data is stored.
privacy.s2Item2: Feedback and feature requests — the text you submit and, optionally, your email address if you choose to provide it.
privacy.s2Item3: Contact form — name (optional), email address, and your message.
privacy.s2Item4: GitHub OAuth — if you sign in via GitHub, we receive your GitHub username, display name, avatar URL, and primary email address.
privacy.s2Item5: Technical logs — our hosting providers (Vercel, Render) automatically record standard server logs (IP, timestamps, HTTP status). These are governed by the providers' own policies.
privacy.s3p1: We process your data on the following legal bases:
privacy.s3Item1: Art. 6(1)(a) — Consent: When you voluntarily provide your email address in a form.
privacy.s3Item2: Art. 6(1)(b) — Contract performance: When you use community features (feedback, feature requests) that require an account.
privacy.s3Item3: Art. 6(1)(f) — Legitimate interests: For anonymous download counting and platform security, without collecting personal data.
privacy.s4p1: We retain data for the minimum period necessary:
privacy.s4Item1: Anonymous download statistics — retained indefinitely (no personal data involved).
privacy.s4Item2: Feedback and feature requests — retained for 2 years from submission, then deleted.
privacy.s4Item3: Contact form submissions — retained for 1 year from last communication.
privacy.s4Item4: GitHub OAuth data — retained until you delete your account or request erasure.
privacy.s4Item5: Server logs (Vercel / Render) — per the provider's policy, typically 30–90 days.
privacy.s5p1: We rely on the following third-party services to operate the platform:
privacy.s5Vercel: Our frontend is hosted on Vercel, Inc. (USA). Vercel Analytics collects anonymous, cookieless page-view statistics. Vercel is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Privacy policy: vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy
privacy.s5Supabase: Community data and authentication are managed by Supabase. Data is stored in AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Privacy policy: supabase.com/privacy
privacy.s5Render: Our backend API runs on Render Services, Inc. (USA). Data transfer is governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC). Privacy policy: render.com/privacy
privacy.s5GitHub: We use the GitHub API to display public repository statistics. If you sign in via GitHub OAuth, GitHub processes your authentication. GitHub is part of Microsoft Corporation and is subject to the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Privacy policy: docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement
privacy.s6p1: As a data subject under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.s6Item1: Right of access (Art. 15) — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s6Item2: Right to rectification (Art. 16) — request correction of inaccurate data.
privacy.s6Item3: Right to erasure (Art. 17) — request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention obligations.
privacy.s6Item4: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18) — request that we limit how we use your data.
privacy.s6Item5: Right to data portability (Art. 20) — request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy.s6Item6: Right to object (Art. 21) — object to processing based on legitimate interests.
privacy.s6p2: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at datengtankoua@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s7p1: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data: HTTPS for all traffic, database-level Row Level Security (RLS) via Supabase, and secret management via environment variables (no secrets in source code).
privacy.s7p2: No internet transmission is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s8p1: We use essential cookies and local storage for authentication sessions and user preferences (language, theme). Vercel Analytics is cookieless. For full details, please see our Cookie Policy.
privacy.s9p1: This platform is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe we have inadvertently done so, please contact us immediately.
privacy.s10p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page indicates the most recent revision. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s11p1: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The competent authority for the state of Hesse, Germany is:
privacy.s11p2: Der Hessische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Postfach 3163, 65021 Wiesbaden, Germany. Tel: +49 611 1408-0 — datenschutz.hessen.de
privacy.s11p3: You may also contact the supervisory authority in your EU member state of habitual residence.

cookies.metaDesc: Learn about the cookies and local storage used by the intellij-deodorant-reborn platform.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how the intellij-deodorant-reborn platform uses cookies and similar browser technologies to ensure the platform functions correctly and to understand how it is used.
cookies.s1p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit, such as your preferred language or login status.
cookies.s1p2: We also use browser local storage — a similar technology that stores data in your browser without an expiry date, until you clear it manually.
cookies.s2EssentialDesc: Strictly necessary for the platform to function. Without them, authentication and language selection would not work.
cookies.s2E1Purpose: Stores your selected interface language (EN, DE, or FR).
cookies.s2E2Purpose: Supabase authentication session tokens. Required when you are signed in.
cookies.s2AnalyticsDesc: We use Vercel Analytics, which is privacy-friendly and does NOT set any cookies. It collects anonymous, aggregate page-view data using hashed, non-identifiable signals.
cookies.s2AnalyticsNote: No analytics cookies are set. Vercel Analytics is completely cookieless.
cookies.s2PreferenceDesc: The following items are stored in your browser's local storage:
cookies.s2P2Purpose: Records that you have acknowledged this cookie banner.
cookies.s2AdvertisingDesc: We do not use any advertising, marketing, or cross-site tracking cookies. No data is shared with advertising networks.
cookies.s3p1: Essential cookies do not require consent as they are strictly necessary for the platform to operate. Vercel Analytics is cookieless and does not require consent.
cookies.s3p2: Acknowledging the cookie banner stores your preference in local storage so the banner is not shown again.
cookies.s4p1: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings:
cookies.s4Item1: Google Chrome — Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
cookies.s4Item2: Mozilla Firefox — Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
cookies.s4Item3: Safari — Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data
cookies.s4Item4: Microsoft Edge — Settings → Cookies and site permissions
cookies.s4p2: Disabling essential cookies may prevent authentication and language selection from working.
cookies.s5p1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the latest update.
cookies.s6p1: Questions about our use of cookies? Contact us at datengtankoua@gmail.com.
